items.text: SEASON 6 · EPISODE 11 · BOSS LEVEL · DRAFT  Design and redline — catch bad engineering before construction · Level 2  Linden Row Design, 6 p.m. The Playhouse drawing set goes out to bid at 9 a.m. Every mistake left in it becomes a change order, a delay or a danger. Anselm has gone home; the redlines are yours.  ⚑ CH-01 · BOSS-01: five physics challenges, a signal trace and the calls that aren't yours to make — on the clock. Fail anything and the run starts over. The edge of the screen glows yellow under pressure, red when time is short or the run fails, green when you clear it; it pulses no faster than once a second, and holds steady if you prefer reduced motion.

narration: 9 a.m. The set goes out clean: the rooms work, the cameras won't moiré, the fixtures fit the throw, the wireless is coordinated and every sheet is signed by the engineer who owns it.
items.caption: Cleared. Written down. Handed over.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Under pressure, the method doesn't change: trace the signal from source to destination, fix one thing at a time and prove it where the people are, and hand every decision that isn't yours to the person who owns it — the electrician, the rigger and structural engineer, the network owner, security, the emergency managers, the clinical and privacy owners, the artist. Then write it down.
